prompt:
Funny Woman

A cheerful young East Asian girl in her mid-teens standing outdoors on a sunny spring day, full-body shot from a slight low angle. She has fair skin, soft black hair styled in two long twin braids with neat bangs, and is wearing thin round wire-rimmed glasses. She smiles brightly with her mouth open, looking directly at the camera with a warm, joyful expression.

She wears a short-sleeved cream-colored blouse with delicate small floral embroidery in soft pink and green tones, layered under a bright orange sleeveless pinafore dress with a fitted bodice, thin straps, and a flared knee-length skirt that catches the light. In both hands she holds a yellow-and-white checkerboard pattern canvas tote bag in front of her waist. On her feet are white ankle socks and classic black Mary Jane shoes with a single strap.

The background is a lush public park filled with vibrant green trees and dense foliage under a clear bright blue sky. Orange cosmos flowers and other wildflowers bloom in the grass around a low wooden rail fence. Soft natural sunlight creates gentle shadows and a warm, airy atmosphere. Photorealistic style, high detail, natural lighting, shallow depth of field, vibrant yet soft spring color palette.
